description: The penalty twin of `linear_ring`, for the equivalence of the two parametrisations at the base point: every field as in `linear_ring` except spatial.parametrisation penalty, lr 9e-5, 10^7 epochs and records every 5 x 10^4 epochs. linear_teacher with an orthonormal teacher and latents uniform on [0, 1]; L = 1, phi id, g 1; k0 = k1 = 1 (input and output kernels of length_scale 0 and amplitude 1, weight_lambda 1); r = rate_lambda = 0; SGLD, float64; every population on the deterministic grid with box = N, so length scales are in sites; init prior. One sample per member, its final state; statistics are read off the member-averaged final-state spectrum with bootstrap errors over members, after removing the frequencies the penalty floor raises (min_rel_eig of the top hidden eigenvalue) from both paths' spectra; the records feed only the relaxation diagnostic. The two presets are separate experiments because the paths need different lr and n_epochs, which an experiment's axes can only cross; the same one-value beta axis gives both the same setting, and so the same exp hash and setting directory (the exp hash covers only the axes): they must be run in separate ROOTs. They are compared each with its own prediction and with each other by fct.linear_ring.paths_disagree: their deviations from their own predictions must agree within EQUIVALENCE_N_SE = 3 combined bootstrap SEs, with the follow-up at FOLLOW_UP_FACTOR times B. lr is 0.9 of what the penalty's run-start check accepts: lr weight_lambda stiffness / (2 beta) = 0.90 with stiffness 1 / (min_rel_eig lambda_0), min_rel_eig 1e-6, which inflates the variance of the floored modes (|q| >= 215 of 512) by 1/(1 - 0.90) = 10x; they carry 1.3e-7 of the predicted power (1.3e-6 inflated) and are excluded from both paths' statistics. Run length: whitened SGLD in xi is Langevin on W with mobility K (W = K^1/2 xi, identity input and output kernels), the penalty path has unit mobility, so one whitened lr-epoch unit along hidden frequency q is lambda_q / lr penalty epochs. lambda_q / lambda_0 = exp(-2 pi^2 ell^2 q^2 / N^2) is at least 0.99 up to |q| = 5 and 0.970 at |q| = 10, where the relaxing power sits, so taking one unit as lambda_0 / lr = 5.01 / 9e-5 = 5.6 x 10^4 penalty epochs errs on the safe side (the units at |q| = 10 are 3% shorter). The whitened statistics' deficit falls below 0.2 SE at B_max by lr t = 85 (the slow tail has a time constant of 17-20 units), 4.7 x 10^6 penalty epochs; 10^7 epochs (lr t = 180) are twice that. The relaxation fit of the second half of the records must find the run stationary (fct.linear_ring.is_stationary against budget_se). The penalty path has no data-curvature check. Cost: about 8 ms per epoch for all 32 members on an RTX 4500 Ada GPU in float64 (39 ms on 8 CPU threads), about 22 GPU hours.
